message: 絆は誰も裏切らない

name: Melilot
message: 「Good morning, everyone」

name: Everyone
message: 「Good morniiiing!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please keep quiet in the library. Now then, I called you all here for one specific reason」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What could it be...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You have all done remarkably well enduring such harsh trials up until now」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't tell me this means it's all over...」

name: Melilot
message: 「An end is also a beginning. However, that beginning is something you must carve out with your own hands」

name: Melilot
message: 「Tonight, we will destroy the magic circle」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The magic circle...」

name: Ria
message: 「That's the magic circle Soltia and Pasta set up... right」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. By destroying it, we can thwart one of the Demon's schemes」

name: Synn
message: 「But if we do that, they won't just sit back and watch」

name: Melilot
message: 「Without a doubt, 'Soltia will appear to interfere'」

name: Melilot
message: 「As I mentioned before, I will be handling the destruction of the magic circle, during which I will be completely unable to move」

name: Melilot
message: 「If Soltia appears, the Crusaders will have to face her entirely on your own」

name: Synn
message: 「So we'll be fighting that Soltia all by ourselves...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Everything you have cultivated until now has by no means been in vain. Please have confidence」

name: Helena
message: 「One person's strength might be tiny. Even so, if we band together and become one great force, I'm sure we can win」

name: Melilot
message: 「Are you mentally prepared--」

name: Synn
message: 「We're ready whenever you are. Right, everyone」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is that so. Any possibility of defeat within me has vanished. We have left nothing to chance. This will surely succeed」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll pull it off!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Understood. I will now explain the outline of our operation」
In short, we're going out of our way to thwart the enemy's objective.
We have to act with the expectation of walking right into their trap.
What they'll seal away is undoubtedly the Demon Lord's power. Suppressing the unknown variable that is the Demon Lord is without a doubt Soltia's aim.
However, Melilot-san had said:
There's no way she's fully anticipated that the other Crusaders--Ria-senpai and the rest--could become viable combatants.
She said it as if it were the most obvious thing in the world, noting that even she herself hadn't seen through that phenomenon.
The probability of Soltia arriving at that answer is close to zero, she claimed. What immense confidence. Yet the way she speaks without a shred of hesitation is reassuring.
To begin with, if I were all by myself, there's no way I could accomplish anything.
Only with everyone by my side am I born as the Demon Lord.
That's something we've all realized ever since the Student Council was first founded.
Against opponents who believe in nothing but their own individual strength, we have plenty of chances to win.
Now, the time to test our true worth is drawing near.
Our bonds will raise the signal fire of our counterattack.
That distant land was filled with silence.

name: Melilot
message: 「First checkpoint. Extremely dense magical power hangs in the air here」
As Melilot-san began to speak in a tongue not of this world,
Then, a pillar of magical power-one corner of a magic circle driven in like a wedge-revealed itself.

name: Soltia
message: 「You may have thought you were luring me in by letting me sense your presence, but」

name: Soltia
message: 「This place is already my territory. So you've finally shown yourselves」
The magical power begins to fade from Melilot-san. At the same time, a tremendous power drained away from my body as well.

name: Soltia
message: 「Someone of your caliber might have been able to draw close to the angels, and yet」

name: Melilot
message: 「I have no interest in such things」

name: Soltia
message: 「And so you fell to the status of a 'Witch'」

name: Soltia
message: 「A clan bound by Re-Crea. Have you ever once looked at your own face, bereft of dreams and hope?」

name: Soltia
message: 「You can afford to be so composed because you hold the Demon Lord as a pawn in your hand, yes?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Can one who surpasses even me truly be called a mere pawn?」

name: Soltia
message: 「However, this is inside my barrier--a space that nullifies magical power. I foresaw long ago that the Demon Lord would dabble in magic」

name: Melilot
message: 「Which means you, who possess Spirit Power, are permitted to act freely within it, I take it」

name: Soltia
message: 「If only you hadn't abandoned your potential as an angel, you might still have lived」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, you are merely an imitation. There is no way you can bring out your true power」

name: Soltia
message: 「It is more than enough power when dealing with the powerless」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't let that happen」

name: Soltia
message: 「Do you really think someone merely borrowing the authority of an angel can defeat me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I have something that you don't」

name: Soltia
message: 「Don't get cocky, Demon Lord!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Because Synn has us with him」

name: Soltia
message: 「How insolent for a mere human」

name: Melilot
message: 「You have misunderstood the Demon Lord's power. That was an outcome that defied even my expectations」

name: Soltia
message: 「What did you say?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is just as Sakura-kun said. Magical power was nothing more than a catalyst to draw it out」
Calling back the power that should have been lost.

name: Melilot
message: 「At times, knowledge ends up hindering possibility」

name: Soltia
message: 「......And what of it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「So you dispelled the barrier. Quite a courageous choice, though......」

name: Soltia
message: 「Where are you going, Melilot!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Things should proceed well enough even without me. The Crusaders will be your opponents」

name: Soltia
message: 「Don't mess with me!!」

name: Soltia
message: 「......!! Don't tell me, the magic circle......?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well then, everyone of the Crusaders, I leave the rest to you」

name: Soltia
message: 「That's convenient then...... Melilot still doesn't know about \{that matter|\s12\s12\s12\s12}」

name: Soltia
message: 「Heehee.」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you laughing at?」

name: Soltia
message: 「As long as I don't let my guard down, there's nothing to fear」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't think we're the same as before!!」

name: Soltia
message: 「I'll show you. An unknown realm you've yet to experience」

name: Synn
message: 「Something like that...」

name: Soltia
message: 「The traps I've laid out aren't limited to just this, you know」

name: Soltia
message: 「I wonder if you can withstand this onslaught?」

name: Synn
message: 「We're definitely going to win. Let's go, Everyone!!」
